scope: Read-only recomputation from saved artifacts; no reset, step, training, model loading, or source edits. Physical extrema are 1kHz sampled maxima, not continuous-time extrema. Recovery quality comparison excludes reset settling; reset extrema retained separately.

definition.paired_csv_and_this_summary_admissible: original standing AND envelope with all31 declared velocity limits AND all five preregistered integration-contact/speed comparisons
definition.integration_forces: Actual integration-solve arrays at pre-state; joint q/dq at post-integration state. No post-forward force substituted.
definition.joint_csv: Full precision per-joint 1kHz aggregates generated by observer; compact NPZ retains independent per-substep maxima, not all per-joint raw vectors.
definition.reset_integration_state: Independently checked qpos/qvel/149-observation against preflight and A/B. Complete integration_state mismatch is runner-reported 0; only preflight full integration-state vectors were retained.

initial_states.selection_before_outcomes: Runner records reset-only preflight completed and hashes frozen selection before controller loop; ordered first20 accepted independently verified. File timestamps are not the evidence of order.

conclusion: All20 pairs completed from20 distinct physical starts; A and B both pass original standing, declared envelope and five baseline-quality comparisons. Success-time differences are zero. This batch does not prove PPO improves success rate or recovery time; 40 rollouts are20 paired initial states, not40 independent starts.
